verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same. In both, the shoe circle is shrunk into the lower-left corner, so the hero image loses impact. The 'Full review inside.' line floats on its own to the right of the circle, small and lined up with nothing. There is also dead space under and around the circle. The difference is the headline. In A it sits with even gaps above and below (about 75px to the logo row and 70px to the circle). In B it drops lower, leaving a big gap under the logo and squeezing the headline against the circle, so A's vertical rhythm is slightly better.
